# Bundled QR libraries

- qrcode-generator 1.4.4, Kazuhiko Arase, MIT: https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator
- jsQR 1.4.0, Cosmo Wolfe and contributors, Apache-2.0: https://github.com/cozmo/jsQR

JavaScript files are unmodified npm distribution artifacts. License texts are bundled alongside them. Both execute locally without network requests. qrcode-generator includes its copyright/license notice in qrcode.js.
